description: Read-only Google Merchant Center feed diagnostics for MCP clients: disapprovals, product-level diagnosis, landing-page price/availability mismatch checks and ranked fix plans. Microsoft Merchant Center (Bing) cross-check coming soon on the hosted service.

authentication.instructions: Connect your Google Merchant Center account at https://feeds.theownersdesk.net/connect/google to get an encrypted bearer token, then send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.title: List Merchant Center Accounts & Stores
tools.description: Lists accessible Google Merchant Center accounts (Merchant API v1) and Microsoft Merchant Center stores (Bing Content API) normalized to one schema. Read-only and stateless.

credentials.description: Optional per-call credential overrides. If omitted, credentials are resolved from the HTTP Authorization Bearer token / headers or self-host environment variables.

googleAccessToken.description: Optional per-request Google OAuth 2.0 access token (scope: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/content).

googleMerchantAccountId.description: Optional Google Merchant Center account ID (e.g., "123456789").

microsoftAccessToken.description: Optional per-request Microsoft Advertising OAuth 2.0 access token (scope: https://ads.microsoft.com/msads.manage).

microsoftMerchantId.description: Optional Microsoft Merchant Center Store ID (e.g., "987654").
